text:
Lina Morales: Quick microcopy thread  Were refining the error message shown when a model fails to load in the console preview pane. Current: 'Model failed to load. Try again.' Need suggestions that help users debug without overwhelming non-technical PMs. Also accessibility + i18n constraints.
Jordan Park: Short helpful errors work best. Maybe include an action hint: 'Model failed to load. Refresh the page or try a different model.'
Samir Patel: Also log ID could be helpful for support: 'Model failed to load (error id: {{err_id}}). Try refresh or contact support with the error id.' Keep parens.
Olga Kuznetsova: For screen readers, ensure the error region has role=alert and `aria-live=assertive`. Avoid stacked sentences that repeat when the pane re-renders.
Rohit Desai: Our error objects sometimes include transient codes like TIMEOUT or OOM. Maybe map common codes to friendlier text via i18n keys. Eg `error.model.load.timeout` -> 'Model load timed out. Try again or reduce context length.' We can surface a short hint for known codes.
Nora Kim: From UX research: non-technical users found 'Try again' unclear. They want 'Try again later' or 'Contact support' options. Could show a primary action 'Retry' and a secondary link 'Get help' that opens a modal with steps.
Lina Morales: Draft variants
1) Generic: 'Model failed to load. Retry or choose a different model.' CTA: 'Retry' / 'Choose model'
2) With id: 'Model failed to load (error {{id}}). Retry or contact support.' CTA: 'Retry' / 'Contact support'
3) Friendly: 'We couldn't load the model just now. Try again, or open support for help.'
Which feels best?
Jordan Park: Option 1 for general, option 2 when `err_id` exists. Also show an inline small link 'View logs' for advanced users.
Samir Patel: Implementation note: avoid showing raw error codes unless user is in a workspace with support entitlement. Otherwise show friendly mapping and include a 'Show technical details' collapsible for engineers.
Olga Kuznetsova: For accessibility, include `aria-describedby` pointing to a help text that explains the retry action and consequences. Eg: 'Retry will attempt to reload the model without losing your current prompt.'
Rohit Desai: I'll add logic to map error codes to i18n keys and include err_id only when support entitlements present. Also cap the length of technical details to 250 chars.
copy-bot: Saved microcopy set. Keys: error.model.load.generic, error.model.load.id, error.model.load.timeout.
Lina Morales: Final copy to commit:
- Generic: "Model failed to load. Retry or choose a different model."
- With id: "Model failed to load (error {{error_id}}). Retry or contact support."
- Timeout hint: "Model load timed out. Try again or reduce request length."
I'll add these to the PR and include the accessibility notes.
Samir Patel: Thanks. Also let's ensure the 'Show technical details' drawer is keyboard accessible and not auto-open for screen readers.
Nora Kim: I'll add to the research notes that we tested 'We couldn't load the model just now' vs 'Model failed to load' and found small preference for the friendlier phrasing on average.
Lina Morales: Nice. I'll land this and loop back if engineering hits edge cases. :sparkles:
